actions: idempotent publish or observe existing effect
invariants: one revision per unique accepted command
accepted command always has an outbox intent
outbox never exists without an accepted command
claim attempts and lease generations are monotone and bounded
leased state retains one exact current owner and generation
non-leased state has no current owner
only leased state may be marked expired
delivered state has exactly one visible effect and a durable receipt
delivery acknowledgement matches the last claimed owner and generation
dead state has no delivered receipt
idempotent retries never create a second externally visible value
stale authority and lease acknowledgements do not mutate durable completion state
known_ambiguity_boundaries: an expired final lease may be reaped dead after a crash that made one idempotent external value visible but did not persist the database acknowledgement
such a dead-with-visible-effect state is not classified as delivered and grants no production exactly-once claim
hostile_mutants: stale owner or generation acknowledgement completes delivery
